doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Opening, church singing and Merchant Marine
summary: Monk Rowe opens the filming; Witherspoon says he still sings in a Baptist church and served in the Merchant Marine in World War II.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe and it’s a great pleasure to have with me Mr. Jimmy Witherspoon, in Sarasota, Florida. He had a long trip out to the East Coast I would imagine.
Well I’m glad you’re here, and I just want to spend a few minutes talking about your career and did you have some church influence when you grew up?
Yeah, I still sing in church occasionally.
And did I read that you were in the Merchant Marine?
I was in the Merchant Marine in World War II.
